{{Quote|May I have your attention please? At this time, I'd like to take a moment to review our boarding process with you.|The spokesperson|<ref name="OST" />}}
An unidentified '''safety spokesperson''' worked for the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] spaceline<ref name="OST" /> around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="LC blog">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> A [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]], she reminded travelers of the regulations when flying Star Tours.<ref name="OST" /> In performing that duty, she was a successor of the [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 service unit]] nicknamed [[Aly San San/Legends|Aly San San]], who had filled the role<ref name="Star Tours: The Adventures Continue">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> for some time, starting around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="ST2 date">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> Several [[Unidentified Star Tours safety spokesperson (Paris)|Other]] [[Unidentified Star Tours safety spokespeople (Tokyo)|spokespeople]] also reminded passengers of regulations in other languages than she used.

[[File:Angelaspokeslady.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The spokesperson doing a pre-flight announcement behind her desk]]
At some point, that spokesperson worked behind the embarkment desk where bookings for the [[Star Tours Flight 6311]] could be made. By departure time, that flight was nearly fully booked, but a conflict suddenly broke out when a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] started fighting for the last ticket. Stormtrooper reinforcements soon arrived, and the brawl degenerated under the helpless gaze of the spokesperson. However, when a group of other [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding individuals joined the Jedi in his fight against the Imperials, the desk lady armed herself with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. She attempted to shoot one of the swordsmen, but was quickly disarmed. The turmoil attracted the attraction of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and of a hooded [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], who started [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueling]]. The spokesperson ducked behind her desk during the whole duel, and she only emerged when Vader chose to retreat, putting an end to the conflict. With a look of intense relief, the woman gave the last available flight ticket to the hooded Jedi.<ref name="ITM1">{{WebCite|url=http://www.insidethemagic.net/2011/06/video-star-tours-2-grand-opening-at-disneyland-packs-star-wars-big-action-into-small-ceremony|text=Video: Star Tours 2 grand opening at Disneyland packs big Star Wars action into small ceremony|work=Inside the Magic|author=Brigante, Ricky|date=2011-06-04|archivedate=20110609184318}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You'll be boarding in just a few moments. Thank you, and have a pleasant tour.|The spokesperson|<ref name="OST" />}}
A female Human with a dark complexion, the spokesperson sported a very distinctive [[Hair/Legends|hair style]], which consisted in one single bun on the right side of her head. When appearing on the pre-boarding safety records, she wore a [[Color/Legends|bright-red]] jacket and put on lipstick of the same color.<ref name="OST" />

==Behind the scenes==
The safety spokesperson originated in the joint [[Lucasfilm]]&ndash;[[The Walt Disney Company|Walt Disney Company]] attraction [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], for Disney's [[Disneyland]] theme park in [[Wikipedia:Anaheim, California|Anaheim, California]], and [[Disney's Hollywood Studios|Disney-MGM Studios]] in [[Wikipedia:Orlando, Florida|Orlando, Florida]]<ref name="OST" /> She was portrayed by [[Stephanie Taylor]].<ref name="Endor Express">{{EndorExpress|url=database/safety-spokesperson|text=Database: Safety Spokesperson}}</ref> Originally, it was the [[Wikipedia:Missouri|Missourian]] actress [[Wikipedia:Jenifer Lewis|Jenifer Lewis]] who had been chosen to play the character. She did a three-hour recording session, but the footage featuring Lewis did not make it into the actual ride. Despite that, Lewis is often credited for portraying the Star Tours spokesperson, even though she explicitly denies it herself.<ref name="Lewis">{{WebCite|url=http://wdwnewstoday.com/blog/archives/847|text=Interview with Jenifer Lewis, Voice of Mama Odie & Flo!|work=WDW News Today|archivedate=20130405045259|nolive=1}}</ref>

Other actors were featured in the safety videos seen in [[Tokyo Disneyland]] and [[Disneyland Paris]], speaking in Japanese and French, though droid Aly San San was shown using all language variations in the safety video for ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' starting in [[2011]].

For the opening of a [[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue|revamped ''Star Tours'']] at Disneyland in Anaheim, a grand ceremony was held in the Tomorrowland section of the park. During that ceremony, the red-clad spokeswoman made an appearance, this time played by a Disneyland Tour Guide named Angela.<ref name="ITM1" />
